title: Battle of Novara (1513)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Novara (1513)", at revision 1370270949, opens: "The Battle of Novara was a battle of the War of the League of Cambrai fought on 6 June 1513, near Novara, in Northern Italy. A French attacking force was routed by allied Swiss-Milanese troops. As a consequence, France was forced to withdraw entirely from Italy." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q661940, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1513 battle of the Italian wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
